ministry: Service Alberta and Red Tape Reduction / Technology and Innovation

areas.name: Planning Workspace
areas.description: The authenticated planning session interface used by GoA Business Analysts and Developers to initiate, conduct, and export AI-assisted planning sessions. All pages require Keycloak authentication with the planner-user role.

pages.title: My Planning Sessions
pages.description: The authenticated entry point showing all planning sessions belonging to the logged-in user. Displays session status, last-activity date, and business problem summary per session, with controls to resume an in-progress session or start a new one.
keyContent: sessions

pages.title: Start a New Planning Session
pages.description: A preparation checkpoint placed before the planning conversation begins. Sets user expectations by describing the planning process, listing what information to have ready, and explaining how the AI Planning Agent will guide the session.
keyContent: Plain-language description of the AI-assisted planning process and what the session will produce
List of preparation items: business problem statement, stakeholder context, known constraints
Estimated session duration and indication that progress is auto-saved
Start Planning Session action button

pages.title: Planning Session
pages.description: The core multi-step planning conversation wizard hosting the AI Planning Agent interaction. Contains the conversational interface for business discovery, the business model review editor, hypothesis review and acceptance, and specialist agent consultation launch points.
keyContent: Conversational interface with Planning Agent streaming responses and inference progress indicator
Specialist agent consultation status panel showing per-service engagement status
Session state auto-save with explicit checkpoint confirmation
Context summary banner on session re-entry for returning users
Graceful error messaging when AI Planning Agent is temporarily unavailable

childPages.title: Business Model Review
childPages.description: The AI-generated business model entity view presented after the initial discovery conversation. Displays extracted actors, processes, and systems with per-entity confidence indicators and source text attribution, enabling targeted review and inline correction before hypothesis generation.
keyContent: sessions

childPages.title: Hypothesis Review
childPages.description: The solution hypothesis summary step presenting the Planning Agent's recommended ADSP service composition with plain-language reasoning. The user reviews, requests revisions, or accepts the hypothesis to proceed to specialist consultation or export.
keyContent: Plain-language hypothesis title and solution description with recommended ADSP service composition
Reasoning section explaining why each service was selected for the identified business pattern
Recommended implementation order with per-service consultation status and specialist launch links
Accept Hypothesis and Request Revision action buttons
Open questions flagged by the Planning Agent requiring resolution before implementation

childPages.title: Export Session Plan
childPages.description: The planning session export page enabling the user to download the complete session artifact as a structured JSON export. The export includes the business model, accepted hypothesis, reasoning, implementation order, and an executive summary section for non-technical stakeholders.
keyContent: sessions

linkedJourneySteps.journey: Exporting a Completed Session Plan for Stakeholders
Review Exported Session Plan and Make Investment Decision

areas.name: Administration
areas.description: The administrative interface for ADSP Tenant Administrators and the ADSP Platform Team. Provides tools for managing the business pattern library, reviewing tenant session history, examining the immutable audit log, and managing user access.

pages.title: Administration
pages.description: The section hub entry point for all ADSP Project Planner administrative functions. Provides navigation tiles to the pattern library, session history, audit log, and user management sections, with role-based visibility ensuring only authorized roles see the governance sections.
keyContent: Navigation tile for Pattern Library with active pattern count and last-modified date
Navigation tile for Session History with count of sessions in the current review period
Navigation tile for Audit Log with HMAC chain health status indicator
Navigation tile for User Management with active user count
Governance quick-access shortcut card for tenant administrators with a pending review obligation

linkedJourneySteps.journey: Reviewing Session History and Audit Log for Governance

pages.title: Pattern Library
pages.description: The paginated business pattern template index showing all active and inactive patterns for the tenant. Supports filtering by status and sorting by last-modified date. Entry point for creating new patterns and editing or deactivating existing ones.
keyContent: patterns

linkedJourneySteps.stage: Access and Orient to the Pattern Library

pages.title: Pattern Editor
pages.description: The create and edit form for business pattern templates. For new patterns presents a blank form with field-level guidance. For existing patterns pre-populates all fields with current values. Provides authoring assistance through auto-suggested keywords and a live similarity check against existing active patterns.
keyContent: patterns

linkedJourneySteps.stage: Author or Modify a Business Pattern Template
Author or Modify a Business Pattern Template

pages.title: Session History
pages.description: A filtered reporting view of all planning sessions within the tenant. Supports date range, user, and status filters. Enables governance reporting through CSV or JSON export of the filtered result set and inline session annotation for tracking flagged items.
keyContent: Filter panel: date range picker, searchable user dropdown, session status selector (active/completed/archived)
Paginated session list: session ID, owner, created date, status badge, and last-activity timestamp per row
Session detail panel on row selection: business model summary, hypothesis count, specialist sessions completed, export history
Inline session annotation field for governance tracking notes visible only to tenant administrators
Export filtered results as CSV or JSON action button for governance reporting

linkedJourneySteps.journey: Reviewing Session History and Audit Log for Governance
Reviewing Session History and Audit Log for Governance

pages.title: Audit Log
pages.description: The immutable HMAC-chained administrative action log. Displays all security-relevant events (pattern created/updated/deactivated, session exported, role changes) in reverse-chronological order with filter controls and a prominent HMAC chain integrity status banner. Supports PDF and CSV export for compliance submissions.
keyContent: HMAC chain integrity status banner: verified (green) or integrity warning (red with ADSP Support contact link)
Filter panel: action type multi-select with plain-language labels, actor dropdown, date range picker
Paginated audit log table: timestamp, actor display name, plain-language action label, affected resource ID, outcome badge
No edit or delete controls on any audit entry (read-only, immutable display)
Export audit log records as PDF (with HMAC chain status) or CSV action button

Security Review and Audit Log Verification
linkedJourneySteps.stage: Audit Log Access and Integrity Verification

pages.title: User Management
pages.description: The tenant user access management page for assigning and editing planner-service roles (planner-user, planner-admin) within the tenant. Supports user search, role assignment, and account deactivation with full audit trail per SN-012.
keyContent: user-management
